verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms https://typesense.org/llms.txt returns HTTP 200 and describes Typesense as a search engine 'for developers and AI agents', giving agents a documented entry point. Agent-oriented docs are also supported: docs pages offer a 'Copy Markdown' option, and guides are served at .md URLs (e.g. mcp-server.md). Missing for 10: evidence of how deep or complete the llms.txt content is (e.g. an llms-full.txt), a working markdown docs index (the /docs/.md probe returned 404), and independent or hands-on corroboration of an agent actually consuming these docs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: PROBE llms.txt: HTTP 200 at https://typesense.org/llms.txt # Typesense
Typesense is an open source search engine for developers and AI agents.
